nodes.label: Unsloth Core

nodes.rationale: Web-based Unsloth interface launched with the unsloth studio command.

nodes.label: Windows Unsloth Installation
nodes.rationale: Documents desktop, Studio, Conda, Docker, and WSL routes for using Unsloth on Windows.

nodes.label: Quality Checks
nodes.rationale: Runs Ruff formatting, Ruff linting, ty, and pytest on push and pull request events.

nodes.label: Release History
nodes.rationale: Records user-visible releases using Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning.

nodes.label: Community Safety
nodes.rationale: Defines respectful participation, private reporting, confidentiality, and proportionate enforcement.

nodes.label: Development Workflow
nodes.rationale: Requires small complete changes, tests, checks, and notable changelog entries.

nodes.label: LoRA Fine-tune Studio
nodes.rationale: Local guided Streamlit application for parameter-efficient LLM post-training on NVIDIA GPUs.

nodes.label: Supported Adapter Methods
nodes.rationale: The application supports LoRA, QLoRA, OFT, and QOFT across listed approaches.

nodes.label: Local Single-User Security Model
nodes.rationale: The application is local and single-user, with no authentication, multi-user isolation, or remote hosting security boundary.

nodes.label: Separated Application and Unsloth Runtimes
nodes.rationale: Keeps the Python 3.14 main application environment separate from the Windows-only Python 3.13.13 Unsloth worker environment.

nodes.label: Job Lifecycle and Persistence
nodes.rationale: Describes durable FIFO jobs, worker ownership, locking, cancellation, resume, logs, and mixed standard/Unsloth execution.

nodes.label: LoRA
nodes.rationale: Low-rank adapters learn small matrices for a frozen linear weight.

nodes.label: QLoRA
nodes.rationale: Keeps LoRA adapters trainable while loading frozen base weights in four-bit form.

nodes.label: OFT
nodes.rationale: Uses structured orthogonal transformations that preserve vector norms and angles.

nodes.label: QOFT
nodes.rationale: Combines four-bit frozen base weights with OFT adapters.

nodes.label: Operational Training Workflow
nodes.rationale: Guides users through launch, system checks, dataset and model selection, training, results, comparison, and Ollama playground use.
